name: plugin_example
description:
A worked example of a local plugin.

Identical to `linear` at its defaults, so any difference in the render is the plugin's parameters actually reaching the shader.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Uniform scale. 1.0 leaves the point where linear would.

parameters.name: twist
parameters.description: Rotates by an angle proportional to radius. 0.0 is no twist, which is what makes the defaults exactly linear.
